description: Call this tool to write one new PDF per range. Ranges are 1-based and may be open-ended: "1-3,5,7-" gives pages 1-3, page 5, and 7 to the end. The input is never modified. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

out_path_pattern.description: Name pattern for the parts: {n} is the part number (1, 2, 3...), {range} is the range itself (e.g. 1-3), {name} is the input name. Example: {name}-{range}.pdf. Each part comes back as a download link valid for one hour

overwrite.description: Replace existing outputs. Default false: nothing is overwritten and nothing is written at all if any target exists

path.description: Name of the uploaded PDF to split

ranges.description: Comma-separated 1-based page ranges, e.g. "1-3,5,7-". An open-ended range runs to the last page

name: pdf_split
title: Split a PDF into several files
